topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The ground is not as it was. My paws sink a little deeper where the earth has been disturbed, a patch of soil lighter than the rest. There’s a thing here, hard and different, not natural like the roots or stones I usually feel. It doesn’t smell of anything I recognize—no bark, no fur, no moss. It’s cold and smooth, lying where it shouldn’t be. I nudge it with my nose, and it rolls a little, whispering against the dirt. The air seems different now, as if the forest holds its breath, waiting. The sky is the same, but everything feels quieter, as if the birds and the wind are far away. I sit back on my haunches, the forest around me too still, too empty.
